Basics

Fresh pasta

Házi tészta

6 months+ Adjusted 50 min 4 portions

From 6 months only when the pieces are very soft and moist. Try a first egg or wheat taste in the morning on a well day, then keep offering wheat through the week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 eggs (boiled in the dough until fully cooked)
  • 200 g plain wheat flour (about this weight; no salt at all)
  • a large pot water (for boiling, not salted)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Mix the eggs into the flour with no salt.
  2. Knead to a firm dough, adding a few drops of water only if it will not come together.
  3. Cover and rest the dough for 30 minutes.
  4. Roll it thin and cut small pieces.
  5. Boil until the pasta is very soft, not merely tender.
  6. Drain and serve it moist, chopped or mashed.

Adjusted

The usual dough allowed a little salt, and firm pasta is too hard at this age.

Make the dough from two eggs and about 200 g flour, with no salt at all. Rest it, cut it small, and boil it until very soft so it can be used from 6 months.
